title: Agent Readiness
subtitle: How complete, consistent and machine-readable your public business data is for Google, Gemini, ChatGPT and other agents.
loadErrorHint: Check your connection and try again.
noScanBody: Run your first scan to see your score, the evidence behind it and the fixes we suggest.
coverage: {{pct}}% of the score could be measured. Parts we can’t measure yet are left out, not counted as zero.
noPermission: You don’t have permission to view this page.
viewOnly: You can view results. Ask an owner or admin to scan or approve changes.
honesty: This is a readiness score, not a ranking. It does not predict where any AI or search engine will show you. Platform rules change; each check links to its source.
fixesEmpty: No fixes to suggest right now.
appliedNone: Nothing was changed: the data was edited since this scan. Scan again.
undoneConflicts: {{count}} item(s) were edited since and were left as they are.
monitoringHint: Re-scans about once a week and alerts you when something regresses.
profileSuspendedNote: Suspended-profile detection needs Google Business Profile access and is not active yet.
historyNote: These two lines are shown side by side. They are correlation only — they do not show that one caused the other.
historyEmpty: History appears after your second scan.

nap_basics.title: Name, address and phone on file
nap_basics.why: AI agents and Google match your business by name, address and phone. Missing or inconsistent details make you easy to skip.
nap_basics.fix: Fill in the business name, phone and street address of your primary location.

hours_defined.title: Business hours set
hours_defined.why: Agents only suggest businesses they can confirm are open. No hours means no confirmation.
hours_defined.fix: Set opening hours for every day you work in Business Profile.

hours_special.title: Emergency and holiday hours
hours_special.why: Emergency and holiday availability is a common reason people (and agents) pick a service business.
hours_special.fix: Mark emergency handling and add your holiday closures.

services_count.title: 8–15 plain-language services
services_count.why: Agents match a request to a listed service. Too few services means fewer matches.
services_count.fix: Add the services you actually offer until you list at least 8, using everyday words.

services_priced.title: Services with “starting at” prices
services_priced.why: Clear price signals help agents recommend you for price-aware requests.
services_priced.fix: Add a starting price or range to each price-book service.

services_described.title: Service descriptions
services_described.why: Short, plain descriptions give agents and customers something concrete to read.
services_described.fix: Approve the drafted descriptions below, or write your own.

service_areas.title: Service areas defined
service_areas.why: Agents need to know where you work before they suggest you.
service_areas.fix: Add at least one active service area.

faq_qa.title: Questions and answers
faq_qa.why: Direct answers to common questions are easy for AI to quote.
faq_qa.fix: Add at least three question-and-answer pairs to your business profile.

gbp_categories_photos.title: Google categories, photos and attributes
gbp_categories_photos.why: Complete Google Business Profile details are the main data agents read about local businesses.
gbp_categories_photos.fix: Check categories, photos and attributes in Google Business Profile. Vireek cannot read them yet.

site_https.title: Website uses HTTPS
site_https.why: Secure pages are the baseline for being trusted and crawled.

site_meta.title: Page title, description and mobile viewport
site_meta.why: These basics tell crawlers and agents what the page is about.
site_meta.fix: Add a page title, a meta description and a viewport tag.

site_jsonld_business.title: LocalBusiness structured data
site_jsonld_business.why: Structured data states your name, phone, address, hours and area in a machine-readable form.
site_jsonld_business.fix: Paste the generated JSON-LD into your website’s home page.

site_jsonld_service.title: Service structured data
site_jsonld_service.why: Lists what you offer, with prices, in a form agents can read.
site_jsonld_service.fix: Include the Service/OfferCatalog data from the generated JSON-LD.

site_jsonld_faq.title: FAQ structured data
site_jsonld_faq.why: Makes your questions and answers machine-readable. Google limits FAQ rich results, so this is not a promise of a rich result.
site_jsonld_faq.fix: Include the FAQPage data from the generated JSON-LD.

site_booking_link.title: Booking link on your site
site_booking_link.why: A visible way to book lets customers and agents act immediately.
site_booking_link.fix: Add a clear “Book online” link to your home page.

site_click_to_call.title: Click-to-call phone link
site_click_to_call.why: On mobile, a tap-to-call link is the fastest way to reach you.
site_click_to_call.fix: Make your phone number a tel: link.

site_speed.title: Server response time (single sample)
site_speed.why: Slow pages lose visitors. This is one measurement of server response, not a Core Web Vitals result.
site_speed.fix: Check hosting and caching, and measure Core Web Vitals with Google’s tools.

phone_ai_number.title: Calls answered by Vireek
phone_ai_number.why: An answered phone is what turns a recommendation into a booked job.

phone_after_hours.title: After-hours call handling
phone_after_hours.why: Voicemail as the default loses emergency callers.
phone_after_hours.fix: Set after-hours handling to AI answer for your primary location.

phone_answer_time.title: Call-to-answer time
phone_answer_time.why: Fast answers matter, but Vireek does not track this per call yet.

reviews_volume.title: Review volume
reviews_volume.why: More reviews give agents more evidence you are a real, active business.

reviews_recency.title: Recent reviews
reviews_recency.why: Recent reviews show you are active now.
reviews_recency.fix: Aim for a few new reviews every quarter.

reviews_response.title: Review replies
reviews_response.fix: Reply to unanswered reviews in Reputation.

booking_enabled.title: Online booking on
booking_enabled.why: Bookable businesses are easier for agents to act on.
booking_enabled.fix: Turn on online booking in Booking Settings.

booking_feed.title: Verified availability feed
booking_feed.why: Only verified, real availability is ever published.
booking_feed.fix: Switch the availability feed on in Google Booking once its checks pass.

booking_partner.title: Google partner status
booking_partner.why: Real-time booking through Google opens only after Google approves the integration.
booking_partner.fix: Track your application in Google Booking.

nap_site_match.title: Website phone matches your profile
nap_site_match.why: Different phone numbers across sources make agents distrust the data.
nap_site_match.fix: Use the same phone number on your site and in Vireek.

nap_directories.title: Consistency across directories
nap_directories.why: Directories should show the same name, address and phone.
nap_directories.fix: Check your top directories manually. Vireek does not scan them yet.

ai_samples.title: AI visibility (sampled)
ai_samples.why: Shows whether sample questions to AI assistants mention you. A sample, not a ranking.

evidence.https_missing: The site is not served over HTTPS.
evidence.jsonld_invalid: Structured data was found but could not be parsed.
evidence.lb_fields: LocalBusiness found with {{found}} of {{total}} key fields.
evidence.booking_link_missing: No booking link found on the page.
evidence.nap_phone_match: The phone number on your site matches.
evidence.nap_phone_mismatch: Your profile phone was not found on the page ({{found}} number(s) seen).
evidence.nap_ok: Name, phone and address are present.
evidence.needs_gbp_read: Needs a Google Business Profile read, which is not connected yet.
evidence.ai_number_ok: A Vireek phone number is connected.
evidence.reviews_none_due: No reviews old enough to need a reply.
evidence.feed_on: The feed is on and ready.
evidence.feed_blocked: The feed is on but its checks fail.
evidence.feed_ready_off: Ready to publish; the feed is off.
evidence.feed_not_ready: Booking, timezone or hours are not ready.

service_descriptions.title: Add service descriptions
service_descriptions.desc: Plain-language drafts built from your price book. Nothing is saved until you approve, and you can undo.

jsonld_snippet.title: Add structured data to your website
jsonld_snippet.desc: Copy this JSON-LD into your home page. It only states what is on file.

hours_review.title: Review hours and special hours
hours_review.desc: Fix conflicts between business and booking hours, and add emergency and holiday information.

gbp_services.title: Update Google Business Profile services
gbp_services.desc: Copy these services into Google Business Profile, or use the approval flow in Google Booking.

review_backlog.title: Reply to waiting reviews
review_backlog.desc: Open Reputation to review and send reply drafts.

publish_feed.title: Publish your availability feed
publish_feed.desc: Open Google Booking to switch on verified availability.

gbp_manual_checks.title: Check Google and directories by hand
gbp_manual_checks.desc: Confirm categories, photos, attributes and directory listings. These cannot be read automatically yet.

notes.templated_draft: These are templated drafts, not AI-written. Review each one.
notes.currency_assumed: No currency on file; US dollars assumed.
notes.address_incomplete: Address is incomplete, so it is left out.
notes.hours_missing: Hours are missing, so they are left out.
notes.hours_conflict: Booking hours differ from business hours.
notes.emergency_flag_missing: Emergency handling is not set up.

alerts.hours_changed: Your hours or holidays changed since the last scan.
alerts.feed_stale: The availability feed is on but no longer meets its checks.
alerts.site_regression: Your website lost its LocalBusiness data.
alerts.site_unreachable: Your website could not be reached ({{code}}).

errors.bad_url: That does not look like a website address.
errors.bad_scheme: Only http and https addresses work.
errors.credentials: Remove the username and password from the address.
errors.bad_port: Only standard web ports are supported.
errors.ip_literal: Use a domain name, not an IP address.
errors.blocked_address: That site could not be reached from a public address.
errors.robots: This site’s robots.txt does not allow automated checks, so we did not read it.
errors.timeout: The site took too long to answer.
errors.network: We could not connect to that site.
errors.redirect: The site redirected too many times.
errors.not_html: That address is not a web page.
errors.rate_limited: Too many checks. Please try again in about an hour.
errors.unavailable: The checker is busy. Please try again shortly.
errors.not_configured: The checker is not available right now.
errors.bad_request: Something was wrong with that request.
errors.forbidden: You don’t have permission to do this.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

public.seoDescription: Check whether AI agents and Google can read your home-service business website. Free, no login.
public.heading: Is your business ready for AI agents?
public.lead: Paste your website address. We read one public page and show your score and the top 5 fixes. Free, no login.
public.privacy: We read only the single public page you enter, follow its robots.txt, and do not store the address or the page. Counts are kept as anonymous hashes to limit abuse.
public.scope: This free check scores your website only. Business profile, phone, reviews and booking checks need your Vireek account.
public.noFixes: No fixes needed on the website checks we ran.
public.ctaBody: Vireek answers your calls 24/7 and can generate the structured data, descriptions and reply drafts for you to approve.
